breaking.member: og ui sheet, og ui review
breaking.change: Both commands are gone, with the engine package's review sheets (`sheets/`, `ui-sheet/`, `extensions/materials/sheet`) they rendered. The built-in components are TSX, each with its own `fixtures` export, and the engine's UI gallery renders every fixture under every pack.
breaking.fix: Capture a game's own screens with `og ui preview` (and measure them with `og ui check`), naming the pack in the game's look (`ui "<pack>"`).
